university_name: National Taiwan University / Campus Consortium Partner

oia.name: Office of International Affairs (OIA / 國際事務處)
oia.description: Primary administrative point of contact for international student visas, ARC certificates, NHI insurance, and student support.

nia_service_center.name: National Immigration Agency Taipei City Service Center (內政部移民署台北市服務站)
nia_service_center.description: Government authority handling Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) issuance, extensions, and residence permits.
nia_service_center.address: No. 15, Guangzhou St., Zhongzheng Dist., Taipei City

health_center.name: Campus Health Center (衛生保健組)
health_center.description: Receives Form B health exam reports, provides first aid, doctor consultations, and student health insurance claims.

counseling_center.name: Student Counseling & Well-being Center (學生心理諮商中心)
counseling_center.description: Professional psychological counseling, cross-cultural adjustment assistance, and mental health crisis response.

housing_office.name: Student Housing Service Division (住宿服務組)
housing_office.description: Oversees on-campus dorm check-in, room assignments, keys, deposits, and verified off-campus rentals.

academic_affairs.name: Division of Academic Affairs (教務處註冊與課務組)
academic_affairs.description: Manages course registration, add/drop periods, instructor overrides (加簽), and official transcripts.

campus_security_24h.name: Campus 24-Hour Emergency Security Office (校安中心)

suicide_prevention_hotline.name: Taiwan MOHW 24-Hour Suicide Prevention Helpline (安心專線)

lifeline_hotline.name: Taiwan Lifeline Crisis Hotline (生命線協談專線)

foreign_worker_and_student_helpline.name: Ministry of Labor 24-Hour Multilingual Protection Hotline (1955專線)
